bio.text: Jeff Merkley has been a U.S. Senator from Oregon since being elected in 2008 to the seat once held by Mark Hatfield.
Before the Senate he was elected to the Oregon legislature in 1998 and served as Speaker of the Oregon House from 2007, and earlier was executive director of Portland Area Habitat for Humanity.
Born in Myrtle Creek, Oregon, he became in 1979 the first person in his family to graduate from college, and still lives in the East Multnomah County neighborhood where he grew up.
